segments.title: Returns, routed with evidence
segments.spoken: Clocked Return Lab turns messy return emails into traceable recommendations for support teams. This is a synthetic walkthrough. No refund, message, or order is changed.

segments.title: A clear, unused return
segments.spoken: Start with an unused desk lamp reportedly delivered twelve days ago. The tool interprets the customer's statement and recommends approval under an illustrative thirty day policy.

segments.title: Every claim can be inspected
segments.spoken: The recommendation is advisory. Open source linked extraction to inspect the highlighted phrases, then review the policy and safety checks. These are customer claims, not independent verification.

segments.title: Uncertainty escalates
segments.spoken: Now consider a defective item with incomplete details. It goes to human review. Consumer rights and safety concerns remain with a person, never an automatic denial.

segments.title: Illustrative policy boundary
segments.spoken: A third request reports delivery fifty eight days ago. Outside the example window, the route is decline, but it is still only a recommendation, pending merchant and legal checks.

segments.title: Four Clocked API endpoints
segments.spoken: The separate live integration uses four Clocked endpoints. Protect masks personal information. Guard screens for prompt injection and can halt unsafe requests. Extract returns source linked fields. Decide returns typed assessments. Conservative local policy checks choose the suggested route.

segments.title: Built for clear first review
segments.spoken: This recording used local fixtures, not paid API calls. The public repository contains the Clocked software development kit pipeline, tests, and setup instructions. Clocked Return Lab keeps people in control.
